_doc: Booking settings seed (runtime copy lives in the private store).

group_rule._doc: Owner decision 10 Oct 2026 (controlling). Scheduled group tours of long_tour_min_days+ days: minimum long_min confirmed travelers, normal maximum long_max (exceptions only when approved per departure). Scheduled/shared departures of fewer days: minimum short_tour_shared_min, NO standard maximum (product-specific max only from approved data). Private tours may operate for 1 traveler (separately quoted). Custom Journeys / Specialist Services: group size defined in the individual proposal.

wording.confirmation_message: Your request has been received. Our team will confirm availability, arrangements, and next steps.
wording.selection_note: Choosing a date sends a request. It does not confirm a place — we confirm availability and arrangements with you first.
wording.private_pricing: Private departure available; price on request.
wording.group_size_long: Group size: 6–18 travelers / Minimum to operate: 6 travelers / Need a different group arrangement? Contact us.
wording.weekend_price: From $450 per person on shared departures. Private departures available; price on request.

_status_rules: Limited is set manually per departure (no automatic threshold). Sold out is automatic only where a capacity exists. Booking cutoffs do not close departures unless auto_cutoff_close is true (off until the owner approves a cutoff rule).
_long_tour_rules: Owner decision 10 Oct 2026 18:56 — long (5+ day) shared departures only: minimum-group decision when days_until_departure <= long_tour_min_group_review_days (45); final booking cutoff (booking_window_closed, NOT the Closed status) when days_until <= long_tour_final_booking_cutoff_days (7). Days computed on Asia/Kabul dates. Short tours unaffected.
_currency_doc: Owner 10 Oct 2026 20:47: "$" = USD (confirmed). Public labels keep the "$" symbol (e.g. "From $450 per person on shared departures"); price_display_prefix controls it.
_short_tour_rules: Owner 10 Oct 2026 20:47: scheduled/shared departures of 4 days or less are reviewed for the minimum group 14 days before departure (same pattern as the 45-day long-tour review: known below-minimum with no decision is removed from normal booking; legacy unknown stays manual-contact). No final booking cutoff for short tours.

payments._doc: Owner 10 Oct 2026 20:47 — rules/data only, no gateway. Standard scheduled and private bookings: deposit 25% of the confirmed price; balance due 30 days before departure; a booking accepted 30 days or less before departure is due 100% on confirmation. Custom Journeys / Specialist Services: terms per the written proposal/confirmation (no forced 25%). A booking is confirmed only after (1) acceptance by AfghanTours, (2) Terms & Conditions + Cancellation, Refund & Rescheduling Policy acceptance recorded, (3) the deposit (or full amount) recorded as received.

standard_exclusions._doc: Owner 10 Oct 2026 20:47. Shown on every tour page unless the tour (frontmatter `exclusions`) or the booking confirmation states otherwise.
standard_exclusions.lead_in: Unless specifically stated as included in your itinerary or booking confirmation, the following are not included:
items: Afghan visa fees and other personal visa or document costs
Medical treatment and emergency evacuation costs
Optional activities or services not listed as included
Meals and drinks not specifically listed as included
Bank charges, card charges, payment-provider fees and currency-conversion charges where applicable

legal_documents._doc: Documents a traveler accepts before a transactional payment (booking-side step in /manage/, never on inquiries). Flip terms.full_text_received + effective_date/version when the owner's final Terms text is published.
